designate.description: Keystone authentication credentials for connecting to Designate API.

password.description: Password for the Designate service user.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the pool manager service.

log_file.description: Path to the pool manager log file.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING).

pool_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between pool health checks and status updates.

pools.description: List of DNS pools to manage. Each pool defines a set of nameservers, targets, and health checks.

healthcheck_domain.description: DNS domain used for health checks (e.g., health.example.com).

healthcheck_path.description: HTTP path for health check endpoints on targets (if supported).

name.description: Unique name for this pool (used as section header).

nameservers.description: List of upstream DNS nameservers for this pool (typically authoritative servers).

provider_driver.description: Provider driver class implementing this pool’s backend.

targets.description: List of DNS providers (e.g., BIND9, PowerDNS) that will serve zones for this pool.

host.description: Host (hostname or IP) of the DNS provider.

options.description: Provider-specific options as key-value pairs (e.g., rndc_host, rndc_port).

port.description: Port of the DNS provider (e.g., 53 for DNS, 8080 for API endpoints).

type.description: Target provider type (e.g., bind9, powerdns, route53).

redis_host.description: Redis host for pool state coordination.

redis_password.description: Password for Redis authentication (leave empty if none).

redis_port.description: Redis port for pool state coordination.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling pool tasks.
